concerns.text: Spec restricts topology generation to 'random, scale-free, small-world' (3 classes), but the Idea explicitly requires '5 topological classes' to isolate structural effects. This is an under-reach of the experimental design scope.

Spec limits simulation duration to 'T=100 time units' in Acceptance Scenario 1. The Idea requires 'convergence plots to verify numerical stability' and validation across '10+ random seeds'. The spec lacks a requirement to generate these convergence diagnostics or to run the seed validation batch, risking a failure to meet the Constitution's Principle VI.

FR-001 mandates generation of only 3 topology types (random, scale-free, small-world). The Idea and Constitution (Principle VII) explicitly require varying '5 topological classes'. This functional requirement is insufficient to answer the research question as scoped in the Idea.
